Se preocupó y ocupó de que pudiéramos contactarnos y nos hizo saber que allí estaba 🫶🏻🫶🏻 infinitamente gracias!! 😊 😊

Special thanks to Delvis for the excellent service we received over the phone. He put us in touch with the YPF station on Route 2 where we had forgotten our wallet (and couldn't get through).
